doc: Dangling-thread registry (§25). Defects found by the initial system-archaeology audit (2026-09-13), from actual code/runtime evidence across 6 domain sweeps. severity: SEV-1 blocks the checkpoint; SEV-2 material; SEV-3 debt.

threads.reason: Live daemon settles on a Coinbase candle close (int(settle_bar['close']>=strike), online.py:3701) and derives contract state from an in-house 4-venue 'BRTI composite' (sources.fetch_brti_composite), NOT the exact CF-BRTI index. This is the Gen-4/5 assumption the Gen-6 exact-BRTI work replaced. Runtime paper P&L is settled against labels that diverge ~4.4% from official BRTI (see research/oracle/label_rescore_result.json).
threads.recommended_action: MIGRATE: wire exact BRTI into online.py contract-state + settlement behind PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE_ENABLED; reconcile paper accounting to official outcomes. Owner-gated (touches the running desk).

threads.reason: settlement_map derives the binary LABEL from Kalshi's terminal quote (last captured quote per ticker), not official BRTI exact_yes. Actively regenerated (gateb_result.json, 2026-09-12).
threads.recommended_action: Rejoin labels to contract_outcomes.jsonl (exact_yes); rescore Gate B.

threads.reason: Legacy Coinbase-as-contract-mechanic / Kalshi-resolution-as-label read as CURRENT within their own files though superseded by the _brti variants. mech_fair_brti.py tags its Coinbase path 'historical' but these do not.
threads.recommended_action: Add a HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED header banner pointing at the _brti canonical owner. Keep as evidence (§39).

threads.reason: (p-y)**2 reimplemented inline in 5+ places (online.py:3704/3706/984/990/1912, emit_manifest.py:164, emit_model_observatory.py:85, agent_model_researcher.py:60-74). Highest drift risk of the formula set.
threads.recommended_action: Add metrics.brier() canonical owner; migrate consumers incrementally.

threads.component: Kalshi fee — ~12 inline copies, ceil/float drift
threads.reason: 7*p*(1-p) reimplemented ~12x; some ceil, some float; disagreement_edge.py:47 uses it as a dollar fraction. A prior fee-rounding drift already caused $2,355 phantom fees (online.py:605-615).
threads.recommended_action: Route all fee math through metrics.kalshi_fee_c (per-contract) / online._order_fee_c (per-order); fix disagreement_edge unit fork.

threads.reason: metrics.py owns brier_skill/max_drawdown/ but emit_model_observatory.py:109 (BSS), eod_exec_selection.py:77 + eval_engine.py:145 + run_audit.py:85 (drawdown), and several inline EV calcs bypass the owners.
threads.recommended_action: Migrate inline copies to the metrics/treatments owners.

threads.component: orphan feature 'price'; retired arm kb6 artifact on disk; btc_rl/live.py; ticks.py capture
threads.reason: features 'price' never enters any feature vector; kb6 tombstoned but kb6_logit.json remains; btc_rl/live.py is DEPRECATED Gen-1 (unscheduled); results/ticks.jsonl captured but 'no model consumes it yet'.
threads.recommended_action: Document as known-orphans; live.py -> add DEPRECATED header (already present); ticks capture is intentional forward-investment (keep, labelled).

threads.reason: Uses n_c = total sample count over the full settlement window [close-60,close), which includes post-decision samples; the exact future cadence/count is not strictly known at a decision inside the final 60s. Small (cadence ~constant) but not strictly PIT. Propagates into mech_fair_brti / oracle_residual_brti via the §8 override.
threads.recommended_action: In the final 60s, estimate remaining count from elapsed cadence (samples_seen / elapsed) rather than the realized n_c; or restrict the settlement-aware override to counts observable at decision time.

threads.component: Oracle independence rests on hardcoded FEATS lists
threads.reason: The independent-oracle isolation is enforced only by FEATS lists selecting cb_*-only columns; the source datasets (dataset.jsonl, brti_decision_dataset.jsonl) carry a k_prob column. Adding 'k_prob' to any FEATS list would silently convert an oracle to market-dependent.
threads.recommended_action: Add a checkpoint assertion that no oracle FEATS list contains a Kalshi token (extend FORBIDDEN_MARKET_TO_ORACLE).
